name_zh: 迈克尔·杰弗里·多瓦利埃/海地/医生/独裁/通顿/伏都/贫困/弗朗索瓦/通顿/马库特
description_zh: 让-克洛德·杜瓦利埃 (1951-2011) 海地总统 (1971-1986)，继父弗朗索瓦·杜瓦利埃的子嗣，继续伏都教和恐怖统治，被誉为 "小独裁者", 对拉美政治和毒品贸易产生深远影响。
description_en: Jean-Claude Duvalier (1951-2011) Haitian President (1971-1986), son of Francois Duvalier, continued voodoo and terror rule, known as "Baby Doc Dictator", had profound impact on Latin American politics and drug trade.
reason_zh: 杜瓦利埃代表拉美独裁者如何通过家族继承掌权，如何继续伏都教和恐怖统治，以及如何成为拉美政治和毒品贸易的象征，体现了拉美政治的复杂性。
reason_en: Duvalier represents how Latin American dictators achieve power through family inheritance, continue voodoo and terror rule, and become symbol of Latin American politics and drug trade, embodies complexity of Latin American politics.
